svg.aria-label: What w warm-up rounds before 5 timed rounds leave: bias and noise
svg.text: What w warm-up rounds before 5 timed rounds leave: bias and noise
Top: how much the warm mean (mean of the 5 timed rounds) of a typical query exceeds the mean of the same run's last 10 rounds. Bottom: noise of
an A/A comparison, two runs of the same build in separate fresh browsers (or Node processes): the typical absolute difference of the geometric
mean over queries of the ratio of their warm means, over all pairs of the 3 repetitions and the datasets watdiv-1, watdiv-10, bsbm-100, bsbm-1k.
The current setting is 1 warm-up round (after the cold run). Comunica 55a70ad (rdf-stores 2.9.0), Oxigraph 0.5.13. cloud-4vcpu
